authority: User chat authorization dated 2026-10-26; not stakeholder or Minh approval.
production_behavior: Fail closed when required policy is absent or provisional outside explicit local/demo mode.

pricing.eligibility: exact case-insensitive usf.edu domain; no subdomains or plus-address semantics
pricing.calculation: discount base subtotal, then conversion, then one half-up final rounding
pricing.eligibility_recheck: decided from the current email at every quote and again at payment (Call 5, pricing-011)

inventory.conversion: active hold converts without a second inventory subtraction

purchase.idempotency: one-time key in every purchase form; buyer-scoped, canonical request hash, replay the first outcome; keys kept 24 hours (Call 5, purchase-014)
purchase.validation_precedence: auth -> form key (repeats replay) -> request limit -> event -> sales closed -> currency -> quantity -> ownership/expiry -> discount still valid -> limit -> pricing -> inventory -> payment
purchase.payment_failure: no order, exactly-once hold release, failure audit
purchase.sales_close: at the event's start time (Call 5, purchase-018)

administration.audit_retention: indefinite append-only for MVP; production governance remains open

quick_buy.double_click: in first build (Call 4); same server-side purchase path

not_implemented_by_bootstrap: pricing, inventory, purchase, order, audit, and admin behavior

performance.target: 20 buyers at once: 95% of purchase requests within 1 second, no server errors (Call 5, system-013)
